cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this very, very important tutorial, the SageMaker cleanup.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到非常重要的 SageMaker 清理教學。

cues.en: So, this time the section cleanup doesn't happen at the end of the section.
cues.zh: 這次不在章節最後清理。

cues.en: It happens now because we are done building our machine learning models with SageMaker and what we'll be doing in the rest of this section won't incur any charge.
cues.zh: 現在就做，因為 SageMaker 建模已完成，剩下教學不會產生相關費用。

cues.en: So, let's do the cleanup now so that we are safe with our money, okay?
And actually, well, we already did the cleanup of SageMaker in the previous section.
cues.zh: 上一節其實做過 SageMaker 清理。

cues.en: So for practice, I would encourage you to try to do it yourself first.
cues.zh: 作為練習，鼓勵先自己試。

cues.en: But of course, if you have any doubt, well, let's do it now, okay?
cues.zh: 有疑問，當然現在一起做。

cues.en: So, our starting point here is the Domains page, which you can find here just by clicking Domains just under Admin Configurations.
cues.zh: 起點是 Domains，在 Admin configurations 下點 Domains。

cues.en: It will show you your domain that we created at the beginning of this section.
cues.zh: 會顯示本節開頭建立的網域。

cues.en: So, let's go inside.
And do you remember what we have to delete first?
Well, we can't delete the domain directly.
We have to delete first not even the user profile, but the Canvas app that we created and used.
cues.zh: 也不是先刪使用者設定檔，而是 Canvas 應用程式。

cues.en: And where can we find it?
Well, that's actually in our user profile.
The user profile that was automatically created when we created the domain.
cues.zh: 就是建立網域時自動建立的設定檔。

cues.en: You go inside your user profile, you scroll down a little bit and there you go.
You will find Spaces and Apps here with your Canvas app.
cues.zh: Spaces and apps 裡有 Canvas。

cues.en: And that's exactly what you have to delete first.
So, let's do this.
It's on the right here. We click Delete.
Yes, delete app. We enter delete here and we click Delete.
cues.zh: 是，Delete app，輸入 delete，再按 Delete。

cues.en: And this will delete this Canvas app.
If we scroll back up, we should see it.
There we go. Default is being deleted.
Remember, it takes a few seconds, and afterwards we will see it gone, all right?
cues.zh: 記得只需幾秒，之後就消失。

cues.en: So, actually let's try already, let's try to refresh to see if it's gone because sometimes this deletion is not being refreshed.
cues.zh: 現在重新整理試試，有時刪除狀態沒更新。

cues.en: Okay, so let's scroll down. There we go.
Deleted. Perfect.
First step done.
And now the second step, very easy, is of course, to delete the user profile, which you can do at the top right here.
cues.zh: 第二步很簡單，刪使用者設定檔，在右上角。

cues.en: You click Delete. Yes, delete user.
And delete and delete. Perfect.
And this time it's super fast.
Has been deleted successfully. Perfect.
And there you go. That's what I was telling you.
Sometimes it takes a while to refresh things.
So, let's refresh this ourselves and we will see our user gone.
cues.zh: 手動重新整理，就會看到使用者消失。

cues.en: There we go. Perfect.
And now, finally the last step is, of course, to delete our domain.
So, we can go back to Domain Settings.
And if we scroll down, we will see under Delete Domain.
There we go. Delete Domain.
We click Delete Domain here, which we can do now because we deleted the user profile.
cues.zh: 因為已刪使用者設定檔，所以現在可以按 Delete domain。

cues.en: So, we click here. Yes, delete my domain.
We enter here, delete, and we click Delete.
And yes, your domain is pending deletion.
And this may take a few minutes indeed.
So, actually let's wait a little bit and I'll refresh in a few dozens of seconds.
cues.zh: 等一下，數十秒後再更新。

cues.en: All right, a few dozens of seconds have passed now.
So, let me refresh to see if our domain is gone.
cues.zh: 重新整理看看網域消失沒。

cues.en: And let's see, let's see.
And, and, and there we go.
No domain. Perfect.
So, don't forget to refresh yourself manually because sometimes it does it endlessly, okay?
cues.zh: 別忘記手動更新，有時畫面會一直轉。

cues.en: All right. So, good thing done.
Now, we can safely proceed to the rest of the hands-on tutorials of this section.
cues.zh: 現在安心繼續本節其餘實作。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
